descriptions.it:
I tuoi compiti
• Sostieni gli insegnanti delle diverse classi nell'insegnamento dei bambini e degli adolescenti dai 4 ai 18 anni.
• Prendere ore di supporto individuali con uno o più bambini secondo la guida.
• Si crea la pianificazione settimanale dell'assegnazione del personale e degli stagisti Pedagogici.
• Si partecipa a riunioni di squadra e eventi scolastici. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza e gioia nel trattare con bambini e adolescenti con bisogni speciali
• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco, ulteriore conoscenza delle lingue straniere benefico
• Flessibile, resistente, elevata empatia
• Se possibile, una formazione specifica per soggetto (Istruzione sociale, FaBe) Claudia Westhues Capo della Scuola Ospedale e Ufficio Esecutivo HFE +41 44 762 52 74 Employer Children's Hospital Zurich – Children's Rehab Affoltern a Albis L'ospedale per bambini di Zurigo è il più grande Ospedale per bambini dell'Università in Svizzera e uno dei principali centri di medicina pediatrica e adolescente in Europa con circa 3.000 dipendenti. Ma la cosa più grande del "Kispi" sono i piccoli: fino a 100.000 pazienti sono curati ogni anno. Oltre all'intera gamma di medicina pediatrica e chirurgia pediatrica, il Children's Hospital offre anche una riabilitazione unica per bambini a Affoltern sugli Albi. Non solo dispositivi all'avanguardia e la massima qualità nel trattamento e nella terapia sono importanti qui, ma anche una buona sensazione per le cose interpersonali: In un ambiente familiare, i dipendenti accompagnano i bambini e i giovani passo dopo passo per tornare ad una vita il più indipendente possibile.
descriptions.en:
Your tasks
• You support the teachers of the different classes in the teaching of children and adolescents aged 4 to 18.
• You take individual support hours with one or more children according to guidance.
• You create the weekly assignment planning of the Pedagogical staff and interns.
• You participate in team meetings and school events. Your profile
• Experience and joy in dealing with children and adolescents with special needs
• Very good knowledge of German, further knowledge of foreign languages beneficial
• Flexible, resilient, high empathy
• If possible, a subject-specific training (Social Education, FaBe) Claudia Westhues Head of Hospital School and Executive Office HFE +41 44 762 52 74 Employer Children's Hospital Zurich – Children's Rehab Affoltern at Albis The Children's Hospital Zurich is the largest University Children's Hospital in Switzerland and one of the leading centers for pediatric and adolescent medicine in Europe with around 3,000 employees. But the biggest thing about the "Kispi" are the little ones: up to 100,000 patients are cared for annually. In addition to the entire range of pediatric medicine and pediatric surgery, the Children's Hospital also offers a unique children's rehabilitation in Affoltern on the Albis. Not only state-of-the-art devices and the highest quality in treatment and therapy are important here, but also a good feeling for interpersonal things: In a family environment, the employees accompany children and young people step by step on the way back to a life as independent as possible.
descriptions.de:
Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt die Lehrpersonen der verschiedenen Klassen im Unterricht der Kinder und Jugendlichen im Alter von 4 bis 18 Jahren.
• Du übernimmst Einzelförderstunden mit einem oder mehreren Kindern nach Anleitung.
• Du erstellst die wöchentliche Einsatzplanung der Pädagogischen Mitarbeitenden sowie Praktikanten.
• Du nimmst an Teamsitzungen und Schulanlässen teil. Dein Profil
• Erfahrung und Freude im Umgang mit Kindern und Jugendlichen mit besonderem Förderbedarf
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Flexibel, belastbar, hohes Einfühlungsvermögen
• Nach Möglichkeit eine fachspezifische Ausbildung (Sozialpädagogik, FaBe) Claudia Westhues Leitung Spitalschule und Durchführungsstelle HFE +41 44 762 52 74 Arbeitgeber Kinderspital Zürich – Kinder-Reha Affoltern am Albis Das Kinderspital Zürich ist mit rund 3'000 Mitarbeitenden das grösste Universitäts-Kinderspital der Schweiz und eines der führenden Zentren für Kinder- und Jugendmedizin in Europa. Das Grösste am "Kispi" aber sind die Kleinen: Bis zu 100'000 Patientinnen und Patienten werden jährlich versorgt. Neben dem gesamten kindermedizinischen und kinderchirurgischen Spektrum bietet das Kinderspital auch ein einzigartiges Kinder-Reha in Affoltern am Albis. Nicht nur modernste Geräte und höchste Qualität in Behandlung und Therapie werden hier gross geschrieben, sondern auch ein gutes Gespür für Zwischenmenschliches: In einem familiären Umfeld begleiten die Mitarbeitenden Kinder und Jugendliche Schritt für Schritt auf dem Weg zurück in ein möglichst selbständiges Leben.
descriptions.fr:
Vos tâches
• Vous aidez les enseignants des différentes classes à enseigner aux enfants et aux adolescents âgés de 4 à 18 ans.
• Vous prenez des heures de soutien individuelles avec un ou plusieurs enfants selon les directives.
• Vous créez la planification hebdomadaire des affectations du personnel pédagogique et des stagiaires.
• Vous participez à des réunions d'équipe et à des événements scolaires. Votre profil
• Expérience et joie avec les enfants et les adolescents ayant des besoins spéciaux
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, meilleure connaissance des langues étrangères bénéfique
• Flexible, résistant, empathie élevée
• Si possible, une formation spécifique (éducation sociale, FaBe) Claudia Westhues Chef de l'hôpital École et bureau exécutif HFE +41 44 762 52 74 Hôpital Employeur pour enfants Zurich – Rehab Affoltern à Albis L'hôpital pour enfants Zurich est le plus grand hôpital universitaire pour enfants en Suisse et l'un des principaux centres de médecine pédiatrique et adolescente en Europe avec environ 3000 employés. Mais la chose la plus importante dans le "Kispi" sont les plus petits: jusqu'à 100 000 patients sont soignés chaque année. En plus de toute la gamme de la médecine pédiatrique et de la chirurgie pédiatrique, l'Hôpital pour enfants offre également une réadaptation unique des enfants à Affoltern sur l'Albis. Non seulement les appareils de pointe et la plus haute qualité de traitement et de thérapie sont importants ici, mais aussi un bon sentiment pour les choses interpersonnelles: Dans un environnement familial, les employés accompagnent les enfants et les jeunes pas à pas sur le chemin du retour à une vie aussi indépendante que possible.

titles.it:
Responsabile Mass Spectrometry (m/f) 100% - NCCR Children & Cancer

The Morscher Laboratory works at the intersection of pediatric oncology and fundamental Ricerca in metabolism. Stable isotope tracing is a core methodology of the lab - applied across cell culture, animal models, and directly in patients to map metabolic fluxes at quantitative resolution. We combine this with single-cell metabolomics, RNA mass spectrometry, and proteomics to decode metabolic programs from the whole organism down to the single cell - and to translate these insights into new treatment strategies for children with cancer.

descriptions.it:
Your responsibilities You will lead the day-to-day operations of the MS platform, including scheduling, quality control and sample throughput across metabolomics, isotope tracing and other MS-omics workflows. In this role, you drive method development for LC-MS/MS-based stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, RNA modifications and lipid analysis, including applications to in vivo and patient-derived samples. You ensure high data quality, robust data management and fully reproducible workflows through rigorous QC and precise documentation. You will co-develop and implement automated sample preparation workflows to increase throughput and improve reproducibility. Co-design of the data acquisition and processing infrastructure around Orbitrap Astral instruments will be part of your responsibilities. You maintain mass spectrometry instruments at the highest performance standards and manage service contracts as well as consumables. Contribution to the development of single-cell mass spectrometry methods is expected as part of the lab's technology development agenda. You actively contribute to research projects, from experimental planning and data interpretation through to manuscript writing. Training and mentoring of graduate students, postdocs, and collaborators in MS techniques and experimental design is an important part of your work. You advise on and support the procurement of future equipment and contribute to grant applications for infrastructure funding. You represent the platform in internal and external collaborations across the Zurich life sciences community.
• Your profile Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a closely related field - with a strong mass spectrometry track record; Experience matters. Hands-on expertise with high-resolution LC-MS platforms, ideally including Orbitrap-based instruments Proven experience in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological research context - this is central to the lab's work Demonstrated ability to develop and optimize analytical methods from first principles Experience with or strong interest in laboratory automation - liquid handling systems, automated sample prep, or workflow scripting Interest in or experience with single-cell mass spectrometry technologies is a plus Experience mentoring or teaching MS techniques to non-specialists Strong publication record showing independent scientific contributions Experience running or co-running a core or research facility is a strong plus, not prerequisite Fluent in English; German is an asset but not required Dr. Dr. med. univ. (A) Raphael Morscher Research Group Leader Kinderspital Zürich as an employer Kinderspital Zürich is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland with about 2,500 employees, and is one of the leading centres for paediatric and youth medicine in Europe. Although the hospital may be big, it's the little ones that count: up to 100,000 patients are cared for each year across 47 faculties, where we do everything in our power to ensure their well being. 'Kispi' not only offers cutting-edge devices and the highest quality of care, but also a good sense of interpersonal issues. Alongside its comprehensive range of paediatric medicine and surgery facilities, the children's hospital also offers a unique rehabilitation centre and a research centre.

descriptions.it:
Le vostre
• Responsabilità Prendetevi cura e curate i nostri pazienti in oncologia, sia nell'ambito di studi clinici innovativi (focus fase I/II) che in programmi di "cura compassionevole". Avrai un ruolo chiave nella consultazione del paziente. Sei tu a tirare le fila in background e a coordinare i processi specifici dello studio. Dalla spedizione dei materiali alla pianificazione degli appuntamenti fino al supporto professionale durante le visite di monitoraggio e gli audit, hai tutto sotto controllo. La gestione dell'Electronic Investigator Site File (ISF), l'inserimento preciso dei dati nei moduli di segnalazione dei casi (banche dati online) e il chiarimento delle domande sono con voi nelle migliori mani. Comunichi con le famiglie di diversi paesi (per telefono/video) e le loro équipe di trattamento e organizzi la creazione di seconde opinioni. Il tuo profilo Hai completato la formazione come specialista infermieristico. Hai familiarità con i requisiti legali, etici e normativi per la conduzione di studi clinici e progetti di ricerca. Parli e scrivi molto bene il tedesco e puoi comunicare bene anche in inglese, sia oralmente che per iscritto. Il tuo stile di lavoro è preciso e indipendente. Essendo una persona comunicativa e aperta, ti adatti perfettamente a questo team di studio impegnato, aperto e di mentalità aperta. Dott. sc. nat. Claudia Althaus Responsabile ricerca clinica 41 44 249 56 20 Datore di lavoro Ospedale pediatrico di Zurigo Con circa 3.000 collaboratori, l'Ospedale pediatrico di Zurigo è il più grande ospedale pediatrico universitario della Svizzera e uno dei centri leader in Europa per la medicina infantile e adolescenziale. • Eigenständige Durchführung radiologischer Untersuchungen für Kinder und Jugendliche mit modernsten Geräten (CT, MR, Durchleuchtung, digitales Röntgen, EOS).
• Empathische Begleitung von Patient:innen und ihren Angehörigen. Du gibst Sicherheit und sorgst für eine vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre.
• Übernahme von Spezialaufgaben in Bereichen wie PACS, RIS, CT oder MR und aktive Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer hohen Qualitätsstandards.
• Verantwortung für reibungslose Abläufe und zuverlässige Mitarbeit in unseren vielfältigen Diensteinsätzen. Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Radiologiefachfrau / -mann HF mit fundierter Berufserfahrung.
• Freude, Geduld und Einfühlungsvermögen im Umgang mit Kindern und deren Angehörigen. Du bist ihr Anker in herausfordernden Momenten.
• Organisationstalent, Belastbarkeit und ein kühler Kopf auch in hektischen Situationen.
• Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Begeisterung für interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit in einem eingespielten Team.
• Flexibilität und Offenheit für Neues in einem modernen, wachsenden Umfeld. Daniela Pirani Institutsmanagerin +41 44 249 56 66 Arbeitgeber Kinderspital Zürich Das Kinderspital Zürich ist mit rund 3'000 Mitarbeitenden das grösste Universitäts-Kinderspital der Schweiz und eines der führenden Zentren für Kinder- und Jugendmedizin in Europa. Das Grösste am "Kispi" aber sind die Kleinen: Bis zu 100'000 Patientinnen und Patienten werden jährlich versorgt, in 47 Fachbereichen tun wir alles zu ihrem Wohl. Nicht nur modernste Geräte und höchste Qualität in der Behandlung werden am Kispi gross geschrieben, sondern auch ein gutes Gespür für Zwischenmenschliches. Neben dem gesamten kindermedizinischen und kinder-chirurgischen Spektrum bietet das Kinderspital auch ein einzigartiges Rehabilitationszentrum und ein Forschungszentrum.
descriptions.fr:
Vos tâches
• Réaliser en toute autonomie des examens radiologiques d'enfants et d'adolescents en utilisant les équipements les plus modernes (TDM, IRM, fluoroscopie, radiographie numérique, EOS).
• Soutien empathique aux patients et à leurs proches. Vous assurez la sécurité et assurez une atmosphère de confiance.
• Assumer des tâches spéciales dans des domaines tels que PACS, RIS, CT ou MR et participer activement au développement de nos normes de qualité élevées.
• Responsabilité du bon déroulement des processus et d'une coopération fiable dans nos diverses missions de service. Votre profil
• Formation complétée de spécialiste en radiologie avec une solide expérience professionnelle.
• Joie, patience et empathie dans la relation avec les enfants et leurs proches. Vous êtes leur point d’ancrage dans les moments difficiles.
• Compétences organisationnelles, résilience et sang-froid même dans des situations mouvementées.
• Solides compétences sociales et enthousiasme pour la collaboration interdisciplinaire au sein d'une équipe bien coordonnée.
• Flexibilité et ouverture aux nouveautés dans un environnement moderne et en pleine croissance. Daniela Pirani Directrice de l'Institut 41 44 249 56 66 Employeur Hôpital pour enfants de Zurich Avec environ 3000 collaborateurs, l'Hôpital pour enfants de Zurich est le plus grand hôpital universitaire pour enfants de Suisse et l'un des principaux centres de médecine de l'enfant et de l'adolescent en Europe. Mais ce qui est le plus important chez Kispi, ce sont les plus petits : jusqu'à 100 000 patients sont soignés chaque année et nous faisons tout pour leur bien-être dans 47 services spécialisés. Chez Kispi, non seulement les équipements les plus modernes et la plus haute qualité de traitement sont importants, mais aussi le bon sens des relations interpersonnelles. En plus de l'ensemble du spectre médical et chirurgical pédiatrique, l'hôpital pour enfants propose également un centre de rééducation unique et un centre de recherche.

titles.it:
Staff Mass Spectrometrist (m/f) 80-100% - NCCR Children & Cancer

The Morscher Laboratory works at the intersection of pediatric oncology and fundamental Ricerca in metabolism. Stable isotope tracing is a core methodology of the lab - applied across cell culture, animal models, and directly in patients to map metabolic fluxes at quantitative resolution. We combine this with single-cell metabolomics, RNA mass spectrometry, and proteomics to decode metabolic programs from the whole organism down to the single cell - and to translate these insights into new treatment strategies for children with cancer.

descriptions.it:
Your responsibilities You operate and maintain the mass spectrometry infrastructure, including Orbitrap Astral instruments and supporting LC systems, ensuring consistently high performance. Coordination, preparation, and processing of biological samples for stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, epitranscriptomics, and other MS-omics analyses - including low-input and single-cell samples - are part of your responsibilities. You support the implementation of automated sample preparation pipelines to increase throughput and improve reproducibility. Hands-on guidance and training of students and postdocs in the use of the instruments is an important part of your role. You actively contribute to the development and optimization of LC-MS methods for metabolite quantification, isotope enrichment, lipid profiling, and modified nucleotides. Routine instrument calibration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance are carried out by you independently. You support data acquisition as well as initial QC and processing pipelines. You perform MS data processing and analysis across applications and collaborative projects, ensuring high data quality and consistency. You manage MS data across projects to ensure traceability, organization, and reproducibility. You also help manage consumables, sample logistics, and platform documentation.
• Your profile Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field Solid practical experience with LC-MS/MS - ideally on Orbitrap-based instruments Background in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological setting is strongly preferred Interest in or experience with laboratory automation - liquid handling, automated sample prep, or scripted workflows Curiosity about emerging technologies, particularly single-cell mass spectrometry, is a genuine plus Methodical, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting complex instrument issues Able to work independently and communicate clearly with researchers at all levels Experience in a core facility, CRO, or research lab environment is valued English required; German is a plus Dr. Dr. med. univ. (A) Raphael Morscher Research Group Leader +41 44 249 65 84 Kinderspital Zürich as an employer Kinderspital Zürich is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland with about 2,500 employees, and is one of the leading centres for paediatric and youth medicine in Europe. Although the hospital may be big, it's the little ones that count: up to 100,000 patients are cared for each year across 47 faculties, where we do everything in our power to ensure their well being. 'Kispi' not only offers cutting-edge devices and the highest quality of care, but also a good sense of interpersonal issues. Alongside its comprehensive range of paediatric medicine and surgery facilities, the children's hospital also offers a unique rehabilitation centre and a research centre.

I tuoi compiti
• In questo ruolo, troverete esami di risonanza neuroradiologica in bambini e adolescenti sotto supervisione specialistica.
• Vi presenterete i risultati rilevanti nelle relazioni interdisciplinari e nelle discussioni sui casi clinici.
• La partecipazione a tavole interdisciplinari con diverse discipline pediatriche fa parte della vostra vita clinica quotidiana.
• Nell'ambito di una rotazione strutturata presso l'Ospedale Universitario di Zurigo, si acquisiranno informazioni sull'intero spettro della neuroradiologia universitaria.
• Sei coinvolto in progetti clinici e scientifici e contribuisci a pubblicazioni e contributi congressuali.
• Prepari casi e argomenti specialistici e li presenti nella formazione interna ed esterna. Il tuo profilo
• Hai un titolo specialistico in radiologia e sono particolarmente interessati a neuroradiologia e imaging pediatrico.
• Idealmente, hai già avanzato o completato la formazione in neuroradiologia o radiologia pediatrica.
• Il vostro metodo di lavoro è impegnato, strutturato e caratterizzato da elevata curiosità professionale.
• Ti piace lavorare interdisciplinare e vuoi sviluppare continuamente professionalmente.
• Idealmente, siete interessati all'attività scientifica, nonché all'insegnamento e all'ulteriore istruzione. Dottor Med. Your tasks
• In this role, you will find neuroradiological MRI examinations in children and adolescents under specialist supervision.
• You will present relevant findings in interdisciplinary reports and clinical case discussions.
• Participation in interdisciplinary boards with different pediatric disciplines is part of your daily clinical life.
• As part of a structured rotation at the University Hospital in Zurich, you will gain insights into the entire spectrum of university neuroradiology.

• You prepare cases and specialist topics and present them in internal and external training. Your profile
• You have a specialist title in radiology and are particularly interested in neuroradiology and pediatric imaging.

• Your working method is committed, structured and characterized by high professional curiosity.
• You like to work interdisciplinary and want to continuously develop professionally.
• Ideally, you are interested in scientific activity as well as in teaching and further education. Dr med. • Dans ce rôle, vous trouverez des examens IRM neuroradiologiques chez les enfants et les adolescents sous surveillance spécialisée.
• Vous présenterez les résultats pertinents dans des rapports interdisciplinaires et des discussions cliniques.

• Active participation in your further training is one of your tasks.
• You take part in interdisciplinary case discussions, reports and internal clinic training events.
• Your role includes taking on on-call duties at night and on weekends.
• You keep the electronic medical records including performance recording. Your profile
• You have a state examination (CH or equivalent).
• For this position you have at least 3 years of experience in oto-rhino-laryngology (ORL); Experience in pediatric surgery is an advantage.
• You are a committed, initiative and independent personality with high social skills.
• Your high level of resilience as well as your willingness to work and learn are what set you apart. We offer you a recognized training center in category C for the ORL specialist title, with appropriate supervision and support for your professional development. Dr. med. descriptions.en:
Your tasks
• You care for patients in health crisis situations and use all your empathy and expertise to make vital decisions.
• You will organize the care in close cooperation with the parents and help ensure that the families feel in good hands, even in crisis situations.
• You expand your knowledge every day and complete your practical training in our emergency department and in various external internships in order to gain a wide range of experience.
• You will attend the modular theoretical training at the Z-INA in Zurich as well as additional courses at the Zurich Children's Hospital in order to continually expand your knowledge. Your profile
• You have already acquired your diploma in nursing HF or FH and ideally have one year of professional experience in pediatrics.
• You are a team player and value working in a supportive and collegial environment.
